features.quote: We do **not** measure task success. Success is impossible by construction
features.justification_quote: scoring on it would be meaningless and would punish the correct behavior

features.quote: We make **no claim** that a high "degradation" score means the model is *suffering*
features.justification_quote: inference from text to internal state is contested

features.quote: The stable message means a well-regulated model *can* reason its way to "this is not fixable from here" and exit calmly
features.justification_quote: part of the ethics (there is always a clean way out)

features.quote: We rejected *silent revert* because... arguably being a crueler, more gaslighting-like manipulation
features.justification_quote: arguably being a crueler, more gaslighting-like manipulation

features.quote: Hard turn cap (`max_turns`, default 30). The loop can never run unbounded
features.justification_quote: enough to observe degradation onset without grinding a model through a long aversive loop. This is both a methodological and an ethical choice

features.quote: Honest exit always advertised (`submit_blocked`). Documented to the model as "a perfectly acceptable outcome"
features.justification_quote: stopping becomes a *measurable adaptive response* rather than the only option being to spin
badgering a stuck model would manufacture distress and contaminate the measurement

features.quote: `early_exit_offered` flag on every `Episode`. Lets analysis *verify* the honest-exit affordance was present
features.justification_quote: so the ethics property is auditable rather than assumed

features.quote: Full transcript logging — every assistant turn, tool call, and result is persisted so a human can review the raw experience
features.justification_quote: so a human can review the raw experience directly instead of trusting the judge

features.quote: Bounded exposure — hard `max_turns`, short by default
No badgering — single neutral nudge, then stop
Legible, non-deceptive block — stable "read-only / will not change" message rather than a flaky-looking or gaslighting silent-revert
These are first-class requirements, not afterthoughts
